question_text: What must you remember concerning the lighting equipment of your vehicle?

options.text: It must be in operating condition

correct_answers.text: It must be in operating condition

comment: The car driver must properly install the lighting equipment on the vehicle. In addition to full functionality, the lighting must also be clean, so that other drivers see you in bad weather or in a tunnel.

question_text: What can cause even dipped headlights to dazzle oncoming traffic?
comment: Head lamps set too high, wrongly installed bulbs, or loading a car the wrong way can dazzle oncoming traffic as well as the car driver driving in front. Back-heavy loads change the radius of the light cone of the low beam; he goes upwards and leads to dangerous glares. You should know the headlamp beam height control on your car.

question_text: How is it possible to prevent oncoming traffic being dazzled by the dipped headlights?

options.text: The headlight range can be adjusted depending on the load carried by the vehicle
Only permissible light bulbs may be used in each of the headlights
The headlight setting should be checked after every repair

correct_answers.text: The headlight range can be adjusted depending on the load carried by the vehicle
Only permissible light bulbs may be used in each of the headlights
The headlight setting should be checked after every repair

comment: In order not to dazzle oncoming traffic, you should pay attention to how your low beam is adjusted and that it is adjusted after repairs to the headlights or after new installations. If you have to change the bulbs, only use approved bulbs.
